name: manual_56fef2
claim: v2.5 storage features (background daemon for LanceDB vacuum/embed-retry/scheduled DuckDB refresh, and DuckDB fleet-wide analytics dashboards) are deferred until v2.1's dense-info-layer shape (orama-system docs/v2/67) lands and stabilizes

decisions.notes: Doc 67 explicitly scopes v2.1 to a single in-process LanceDB writer task and a stateless, uncached DuckDB query surface; the standalone background daemon and any materialized-view/dashboard feature work is out of scope until v2.1 ships, since v2.5's daemon writes to a DuckDB-native persisted cache file that doesn't exist yet. Do not start v2.5 daemon or fleet-analytics work before v2.1's two-store shape (SQLite+FTS5 coordination log with the kind column promoted, per-machine LanceDB) is merged and running.
